span.p:
Actions ci.yml
lint, openapi lint, unit,
feature (Postgres 17 + Redis 7 services,
OpenAPI response validation),
compose smoke test

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
package job
buildx app-prod (FrankenPHP) + nginx
amd64 on main, +arm64 on v* tags

span.p:
env: APP_BRAND_NAME=Acme Leave
BRAND_PRIMARY_COLOR, BRAND_ACCENT_COLOR
MODULES_ENABLED=holidays,reports,notifications,user_management
LEAVE_YEAR_START_MONTH=4
KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL=https://sso.acme.example
BRANDING_DISK=s3, AWS_ENDPOINT, AWS_BUCKET

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
secrets: APP_KEY, DB_PASSWORD, REDIS_PASSWORD,
MAIL_PASSWORD, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY,
KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET, KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET,
KC_DB_PASSWORD

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
release: migrate --force (one-off)
then roll app / worker / scheduler
